How would you invest this at the age of 47?

You need to open an investment account. 
Then you need to link accounts. 
Every account you have money that you want to transfer money from. 
You have to transfer or roll money from accounts directly to your investment account. 
Not just withdraw it and then deposit. So link all your accounts. 
Initiate the transfers. 
While you wait for the money to move. 

You make a list of every stock you're interested in. Then you save them as your favorites in a watch list. 
You read them and do your due diligence on each stock and on your strategy. 
Then write out your plan. To get it out of your head and onto paper. 

If you're worried and concerned. There's this thing called "paper trading". Where you pretend to buy them and can track it as if you actually did buy them. 
It's a way to test a stock or a strategy. 

But yeah. That's basically it. 
Open account, get that all set up. 
Link all your accounts. 
Start the money transfers.
Make your strategy. Get the plan figured out. 
Then put in the orders to buy. 
That's it.

How would you invest this at the age of 47?

You need to open an investment account. 
Then you need to link accounts. 
Every account you have money that you want to transfer money from. 
You have to transfer or roll money from accounts directly to your investment account. 
Not just withdraw it and then deposit. So link all your accounts. 
Initiate the transfers. 
While you wait for the money to move. 

You make a list of every stock you're interested in. Then you save them as your favorites in a watch list. 
You read them and do your due diligence on each stock and on your strategy. 
Then write out your plan. To get it out of your head and onto paper. 

If you're worried and concerned. There's this thing called "paper trading". Where you pretend to buy them and can track it as if you actually did buy them. 
It's a way to test a stock or a strategy. 

But yeah. That's basically it. 
Open account, get that all set up. 
Link all your accounts. 
Start the money transfers.
Make your strategy. Get the plan figured out. 
Then put in the orders to buy. 
That's it.
